summary: psrp and winrm both run over WinRM; psrp is newer and can be faster, handles load-related timeouts better, and supports proxies better.
questions: Should I use psrp or winrm for Windows?
Why is psrp better than winrm?

answer_card.title: psrp vs winrm
answer_card.answer_md:
Both use WinRM. `psrp` is newer and:
- can be slightly faster
- is less prone to timeouts when the Windows host is under load
- has better proxy support
